rule: A redelivered checkout.session.completed must not create a second subscription row
notes: SQL transliteration of the webhook handler; covers bounded SQL orders only, not HTTP or Stripe.

statements: INSERT INTO subscription(id,"userId","subscriptionId","customerId","priceId",status,"createdAt","updatedAt") VALUES ('rowA','u1','sub_1','cus_1','prod_1','active',now(),now()) ON CONFLICT ("subscriptionId") DO UPDATE SET status = excluded.status, "updatedAt" = excluded."updatedAt"

INSERT INTO subscription(id,"userId","subscriptionId","customerId","priceId",status,"createdAt","updatedAt") VALUES ('rowB','u1','sub_1','cus_1','prod_1','active',now(),now()) ON CONFLICT ("subscriptionId") DO UPDATE SET status = excluded.status, "updatedAt" = excluded."updatedAt"
